title: Chapter 228 Brotherhood
content:
Chapter 228 Brotherhood

The banquet ended soon, and the generals, who were satisfied with their drinks, shook their heads and staggered out of the camp with each other supporting each other.

In this banquet, apart from singing and dancing, there was also something that made them very happy.

That is, Big Iron Hammer was unexpectedly promoted. He was directly promoted to the fifteenth and sixth ranks. He was promoted from a small general with thousands of people to a general with ten thousand people. It can be said that he reached the sky in one step.

Such an extraordinary reward undoubtedly made many generals see hope and a shortcut to reach a high place.

All the generals secretly made up their minds in their hearts, they must work hard, and they must make great contributions on the battlefield in the future, so that they can become today's big hammers, and they will be proud of themselves.

...

In Big Iron Hammer's tent, although he is a general with thousands of soldiers, his tent is only several times larger than that of ordinary soldiers, and the furnishings inside are still the same.

At this moment in his tent, there were three thin soldiers walking around, anxiously waiting for the arrival of the big hammer.

Suddenly, footsteps sounded outside the tent, dull and powerful. It seemed that the man was not small in weight and stature. The faces of the three people who were walking were happy, and they all looked outside together. They knew that only their elder brother could make this familiar sound of footsteps.

"Brother, are you here? Don't worry about me!" A Gang, who relied most on the big hammer, said anxiously before the big hammer stepped into the camp.

"Yeah, big brother, are the brothers worried about you?" A Jin Amin behind him also responded quickly.

Hearing the concern of his three brothers and the unstoppable worry in his tone, Big Iron Hammer was filled with emotion, but his face was still as tough, without showing any signs, instead he laughed a few times!

"Hahahaha, I've already said that you are worrying too much. You are in the camp of the coalition army, with three kings on top, and a mere Yan Yi, what can you do!"

"Really? At the banquet today, did that villain Yan Yi really not embarrass the eldest brother?" A Gang was a little unbelievable. In his impression, willingness has always been a person who must report all faults and repay them double. , how could he easily let go of his elder brother!

"I've said it all, willingness is indeed a high position in our country of Yan, and it is even more powerful in the army, but this is not the country of Yan, but the camp of the coalition army, with the existence of the imperial country and South Korea. Under this situation How can he dare to make small moves if he wants to?" Big Iron Hammer looked at his brother helplessly, he was good at everything, kind, upright, loyal, and kept his word, but he just couldn't think about it in some places. .

"Really? It's good that brother is fine. I don't know how the banquet was for big brother. We heard that there will be singing and dancing to add to the fun. There are countless delicious wines and delicacies. I am really envious of me. Unfortunately, I am not a general of thousands of people, but just an insignificant Little soldier, otherwise I would be able to enjoy the feast with my elder brother!" A Jin, who was more sensible behind him, saw that his elder brother didn't seem to want to talk about this, so he quickly changed the subject.

Hearing the words, the big hammer looked at the three brothers beside him who had diverted their attention because of A Jin's words. Their mouths were faintly drooling, their eyes were full of strange colors, and they were amused and sad at the same time. .

My brothers, since they followed me, have not had a good life, they are all living a full and hungry life in the barracks.

And because he took refuge in Prince Pill and offended Yan Yi, his salary was deducted completely, and he couldn't get a cent of it. I didn't take them to have a good meal and enjoy it. I am really a dereliction of duty brother.

"Haha, don't worry, as your big brother, how could I only care about myself and forget about you good brothers? This time, I have already asked the king to exchange the reward we got for this time for our military exploits. It has become 100 cattle and sheep, and 200 jars of wine, which will be delivered later. At that time, all the soldiers in our battalion can have a good drink and a good meal!" Hide the guilt in my heart , Big Iron Hammer said the reward he was going to come this time, and looked at the few people with some joy.

"Really? Brother, 100 cattle and sheep, and wine. I haven't eaten meat for a long time. It's been two years, or three years. I can't even remember the taste of the meat!" Hearing this, his face was overjoyed, full of expectation, and he looked at the big hammer.

"That's natural. As your eldest brother, when did you ever lie to you!" Big Hammer pretended to be displeased, and blamed him.

"That's natural, that's natural. We trust Big Brother very much, and we won't doubt anything!" After hearing the words, the three people on the opposite side hurriedly nodded and explained anxiously.

"Hahahaha!" Big Iron Hammer laughed loudly. He always felt comforted and trusted by his three brothers.

An hour later, all the beef, mutton, wine and meat promised by the King of Yan had been sent from the logistics and military supplies, and two carts were filled with them, and a large herd of cattle and sheep drove them. A lot of bitterness next to it haha!

It's a pity that they didn't make enough contributions, and they didn't have a reliable officer. These wine and meat were destined to have nothing to do with them.

When all these rewards were transported to the barracks of Big Hammer, the whole barracks erupted.

No matter what, all the soldiers were tired and went to bed early, or they were slightly injured, and they were moaning in the dark. After the wine and meat were delivered, when they heard the news, they all ran out of their tents and followed the wine and meat, refusing to leave.

Afterwards, after hearing the news, the whole army began to revel all night under the order of the big hammer that came to the front of the wine and meat.

Although it was a clear violation of military discipline for them to do so, it was just that the Big Iron Hammer had been approved by King Yan early on, so the patrolling troops obviously avoided them.

It's just that in the eyes of those soldiers, there was an obvious look of envy when they passed outside the camp of Big Hammer.

They also want to eat meat. In the coalition army, due to the perennial war, supplies have long been in short supply. All soldiers can only eat half full every day, and they often start to feel hungry shortly after eating. At this moment, they smell these aromas. , How can we not make them feel extremely envious and jealous.

In short, the morale of the entire coalition army was boosted because of this reward, although only the Big Hammer was rewarded.

However, the soldiers and generals of the other battalions are also secretly making up their minds that in the next battle, they will never be defeated by the Qin army after two hits like before.

They also want to make military exploits, and when the time comes, they will eat well, drink well, and get promoted and get rich by the way.
